title: Empirical Regime Auditing Under the GCD/UMCP Kernel: Contract-Frozen Calibration, Temporal Diagnostics, Typed Return, and Cross-Stream Evaluation
main_question: How can multistream empirical sequences be calibrated, admitted, diagnostically analyzed and tested for typed return without allowing temporal diagnostics to redefine the kernel or decide stance by themselves?
open_burdens: Prospective domain-local validation of adapters, calibration windows, temporal diagnostics, sentinel rules, and any learned thresholds under frozen evidence boundaries. Domain-specific temporal thresholds are not universalized.
